description: This file defines an abstract class `CompatTab` representing a single UI tab in an Android application, with methods for setting and getting tab properties and a tag. It is part of a tab management utility that adapts to different platform versions.

classes.name: CompatTab
classes.description: An abstract representation of a UI tab that can be customized with text, icon, listener, and fragment, and provides access to its properties and associated tag.

methods.name: CompatTab(FragmentActivity activity, String tag)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tab with an activity context and a unique tag.

methods.name: setText(int resId)
methods.description: Sets the display text of the tab using a resource ID.

methods.name: setIcon(int resId)
methods.description: Sets the icon of the tab using a resource ID.

methods.name: setTabListener(CompatTabListener callback)
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener for tab events.

methods.name: setFragment(Fragment fragment)
methods.description: Associates a Fragment instance with the tab.

methods.name: getText()
methods.description: Retrieves the display text of the tab.

methods.name: getIcon()
methods.description: Retrieves the icon drawable of the tab.

methods.name: getFragment()
methods.description: Returns the fragment associated with the tab.

methods.name: getTab()
methods.description: Returns an object representing the tab, implementation-specific.

methods.name: getTag()
methods.description: Returns the unique tag string for the tab.
